messages:
chloe: heads up — latency chart for API routes lost p95/p99 after the ingress cutover at 09:12. p50 still shows. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.screenshots/abc123 :eyes:
sam: which dashboard/panel are you looking at? route filter?
chloe: Console > Observability > Latency > grouped by route. Panel id 42. Query uses histogram_quantile on api_request_latency_seconds_bucket.
deploy-bot: ingress/edge-proxy v2.3.1 deployed by julian at 2026-03-17T09:12:04Z
julian: I flipped the new ingress tokenizer/cardinality reduction to cut series count. I didn't touch the metrics relabeling intentionally. Could that cause quantiles to vanish? :thinking_face:
sam: can you paste the PromQL the panel uses?
chloe: sure —
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(api_request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
```
sam: running an ad-hoc query against our Prometheus: p50 returns numbers, p99 returns NaN for several routes. Looks like the _bucket series are missing or the `le` label was dropped.
sam: checking kafka topic redwood-metrics-ingest and the Druid ingestion tasks for missing series.
julian: I pulled the deploy diff — we did add a relabel rule to drop some high-cardinality labels. It's possible the relabel accidentally matched metrics with "bucket" in their name. I'll inspect the rule.
sre-oncall: quick repro: curl the metrics endpoint on the sidecar and grep for the bucket metrics. If buckets aren't exported, histogram_quantile can't work.
```bash
curl -s http://metrics-sidecar.internal:9100/metrics | grep api_request_latency_seconds_bucket | head
```
chloe: ran that on one pod — zero results. Only api_request_latency_seconds_count and _sum and summaries show up. No _bucket lines.
sam: confirmed. The relabel config had a regex that matched metric names containing "bucket" and dropped them. That was unintended. File: infra/observability/prom-filter.yaml
julian: rolling a patch to revert the offending relabel now. will deploy in ~5-10m.
deploy-bot: config-change applied by julian at 2026-03-17T09:27:12Z — prometheus relabel updated.
sam: forcing a scrape and re-running the dashboard queries. Next scrape in ~15s.
chloe: p99 returned for route /v1/generate! :tada: checking others.
chloe: all routes restored, p95/p99 lines back across the board.
julian: opened PR to add a unit test + safer relabel rule to prevent dropping bucket metrics. Will add a note in the changelog. cc @sre-oncall
sre-oncall: created incident INC-2026-042, assigned to eng-sre. Timeline + logs attached in the incident ticket. Please add postmortem link once available. Closing this thread when the postmortem is posted.
